summary: This release improves chat continuity, side conversations, browser and desktop tools, and cross-platform updates.

items.title: Release notes in EterX
items.description: Preview highlights in the update notice and read the full notes in Settings.

items.title: Chat startup and recovery
items.description: New chats briefly show startup status before Thinking. History recovery no longer blocks startup or saves; failed writes retry automatically. Activity markers track the answer or latest work note.

items.title: Side chats and Proxy
items.description: Models, reasoning, drafts, pinned files, and settings stay with each conversation. Proxy work resumes without repeating completed tasks.

items.title: Browser and computer tools
items.description: Browser profiles persist across reconnects, with safer tab handling. Computer Use improves window targeting, text entry, dragging, and image delivery across supported providers.

items.title: Terminal and workspace navigation
items.description: Grouped waits return on the first task update. Search previews sources and opens links in the side browser; Recents spans folders and workspace selection persists.

items.title: Chat and code formatting
items.description: Chat input and sent prompts share a background; expanded edits use the side-panel diff font.

items.title: Safer updates across Windows, macOS, and Linux
items.description: Windows updates install silently and reopen EterX, including updates started by older clients. macOS can restore failed replacements; Linux keeps the previous AppImage until the new version starts. Stale installs are blocked and restart results are reported. System-wide Windows installs may need administrator approval.
